	margin: 0 0 1.2rem;

	clear: both;
	float: none;

}

	min-height: 130px;
	resize: vertical;
}

.simple input[type="image"] {
	width: auto;
	height: auto;
	min-height: 0;
	border: 0;
	padding: 0;

	width: auto;
}

	margin: 1rem 0  1rem 2rem;

	color: #990000;
}
